fields.acceptance: A unit test in internal/model (go test -trimpath ./internal/model -run ShowField) gives ShowFieldValue a statement with an @{ID} reference plus <branch>, a & b, x > y and U+2028, and asserts the result equals canon.Marshal of the shown text minus its newline and passes canon.Check; a testscript (go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run TestScripts/change-show-canonical-text) writes such a statement referring to another node, then rhiza check passes, rhiza change show and change show --json succeed and print the text with literal <, > and &, rhiza change diff and rhiza show --json of the node succeed with the same literal text, and after landing, change show of the landed change set still succeeds
fields.statement: A text field shown by handle stays canonical JSON (literal < > & and U+2028/U+2029, as canon writes them), so change show, its indexed path, change diff, show, slice and render read every op that rhiza check and rhiza land accept
